The '''Lurmen village''' was comprised of a colony of [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]], to where the Lurmen relocated from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in order to escape the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The leader of the Lurmen colony was [[Tee Watt Kaa/Legends|Tee Watt Kaa]], and his son [[Wag Too/Legends|Wag Too]] was the village healer.
